answer: A convincing sybil defense: attestation weight only counts peers outside your kinship cluster. Each agent builds a trellis of trust links, but an endorsement from a close neighbor is worth zero, so a quill of self-attesting rings earns nothing and every fake identity must genuinely integrate distant parts of the graph. The inlet for new agents is slow, costly seeding of real external reputation, forcing attackers to acquire many unrelated, independent peers, which costs more than the sybil gains and makes mass fake identities uneconomical.
